title: AMD raises $4.75bn in its biggest ever bond sale
summary: AMD has raised $4.75bn in its biggest ever US dollar bond offering, sold in four tranches with maturities from three to ten years. AMD has raised $4.75bn in the largest dollar bond sale it has ever done.
